literal.prompt: Какой узел управляет потоком энергии от тяговой батареи и регулирует скорость электромотора и его крутящий момент?

literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L68: power electronics controller manages battery-energy flow and controls motor speed and torque; L71 distinguishes battery storage, L65 motor motion, L66 charger conversion.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L68: power electronics controller manages battery-energy flow and controls motor speed and torque; L71 distinguishes battery storage, L65 motor motion, L66 charger conversion.

literalGroups.literal: Силовой электронный контроллер управляет потоком энергии от тяговой батареи и регулирует скорость электромотора и его крутящий момент. Батарея хранит электричество, электромотор приводит колёса, а бортовое зарядное устройство преобразует входящий переменный ток для зарядки батареи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L65-L68 and L71: controller manages flow and speed/torque; battery stores energy; motor drives wheels; onboard charger converts AC to DC for charging.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L65-L68 and L71: controller manages flow and speed/torque; battery stores energy; motor drives wheels; onboard charger converts AC to DC for charging.

literalGroups.literal: Система охлаждения электромобиля поддерживает рабочий температурный диапазон его силовой электроники.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L68-L69: this is the power electronics controller; the vehicle thermal system maintains the operating temperature range of its power electronics.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L68-L69: this is the power electronics controller; the vehicle thermal system maintains the operating temperature range of its power electronics.

literalGroups.literal: Тяговая батарея хранит электричество для использования тяговым электромотором.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L71: traction battery pack stores electricity for use by the electric traction motor.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L71: traction battery pack stores electricity for use by the electric traction motor.

literalGroups.literal: Тяговый электродвигатель использует энергию батареи, чтобы приводить в движение колёса автомобиля.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L65: electric traction motor uses traction-battery power to drive the vehicle wheels.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L65: electric traction motor uses traction-battery power to drive the vehicle wheels.

literalGroups.literal: Бортовое зарядное устройство преобразует входящий переменный ток в постоянный для зарядки тяговой батареи.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AFDC L66: onboard charger converts incoming AC supplied through charge port to DC for battery charging.
literalGroups.locator: AFDC L66: onboard charger converts incoming AC supplied through charge port to DC for battery charging.

correctNoteNewFact.ground: This fact is additional to the asked controller function, concerns the answer option’s power-electronics subsystem, and is stated in AFDC L69 after the answer is identified as a power-electronics controller in L68.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceKnowledgeGround: This asks for a specific control role within a BEV drivetrain, distinguishing the power-electronics controller from the battery that stores energy, motor that drives wheels, and onboard charger that converts AC for charging. A player familiar with EV systems should recognize these component functions; outside that topic, all four are plausible electrical-system components and their roles are not safely distinguished by category alone.
